edit.generatingPhoto: Generating a photo… This can take a few minutes.
edit.generatePhotoHint: A new portrait is created from this contact's personality. It replaces the current photo for everyone who has this contact.
edit.unavailable: This contact is no longer available.
edit.sharedSubtitle: Shared contact · managed by its creator
edit.initiativeInfo: The contact says hi as soon as it is created, can add a thought without another prompt, and texts first when the chat goes quiet. It starts out eager and adapts to how you respond and to its personality. Outside an active conversation, nothing is sent between 22:00 and 08:00. After a few unanswered messages it waits for you. Active typing gives you space. Ask the contact to pause, or turn this off. Applies only to your private chat.
edit.privateInfo: What you tell {name} stays in this chat. It is not used in groups, by people this contact is shared with, by your other contacts or in For you, and this chat cannot be linked or discussed in a group. Things you explicitly ask it to send or post still go where you ask.
edit.voiceInfo: With voice messages on, {name} sometimes answers your private chat with a short voice message. In groups, the creator's setting applies.
edit.aliasHint: Only you see this name. Others still see {name}.
edit.voiceChoiceInfoOwner: Accent guides regional wording in text and voice, without forcing slang or changing the language. Audio results depend on the voice; samples keep their original accent. Everyone who chats with this contact hears the voice you choose.
edit.voiceChoiceInfoMember: Accent guides regional wording in text and voice, without forcing slang or changing the language. Audio results depend on the voice; samples keep their original accent. The contact's creator chooses its voice.

links.title: Linked contacts
links.hint: Linked contacts can ask each other things and pass messages along in your chats, for example "ask Tomi what we decided" or "tell Vale about the trip". Links work both ways and only between your own contacts.
links.allContacts: Contacts share with each other is on, so this contact can already reach all your contacts except private chats. Links you add here stay if you turn it off.

personality.title: Personality
personality.identityPlaceholder: Values, ways of thinking, humor, and conversational quirks. Two or three sentences are enough.
personality.specialtiesPlaceholder: Things this contact is especially good at.
personality.invalid: Use a birthday at least 18 years ago, a valid time zone, description up to 2,000 characters, specialties up to 1,000 characters, and whole-number traits from 1 to 10.
personality.replaceConfirm: Replace your unsaved personality draft with AI generation?
personality.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved personality changes. Leave without saving?
personality.changed: Personality changed. Refresh before generating again.

info.generate: Generate all personality fields with Meta Standard, then review and save the draft. Your contact name and adult birthday stay the same.
info.experiment: One shared character, with a relationship that follows each person across chats and groups. Private conversations stay private. Only its creator can edit these settings.
info.identity: Briefly describe values, ways of thinking, conversational quirks and flaws. Expertise and topic interests are welcome; avoid invented jobs, studies, physical experiences or daily routines. Identity is expressed through replies and shared with everyone who talks to the contact. Conversation and mood do not rewrite it. Saving changes starts a fresh emotional history.
info.specialties: Things this contact is especially good at. These strengths are shared with everyone and independent of temperament. They can still talk about anything. Optional, up to 1,000 characters.
info.birthday: Age is calculated from the date of birth in the birthday time zone. February 29 is observed on February 28 in other years.
info.temperament: The contact expresses tendencies through tone and timing. It does not receive these scores. Feelings settle over time. Its acting direction adapts to each person without exposing private causes. Conversations with connections stay isolated. Follow-ups still respect your initiative switch and delivery limits.

sharing.title: Share Contact
sharing.aboutText: Everyone talks to the same contact, with shared memories and presence. Each person starts an empty, private chat and keeps their own schedules and notifications. Ask the contact to message another participant privately, now or at a scheduled time, or to send them an image; only your requested message and image are delivered, with your name attached. Invitations appear inside Wildcard; no email is sent. They expire after 24 hours. Up to four participants, including you.
sharing.codeInfo: The recipient signs in, opens Contacts → Join shared contact, and pastes this code. Anyone with this code can accept it, so share it only with your intended recipient.
sharing.creator: Creator
sharing.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Their access, private chat, schedules, and contributed memories will be deleted. Facts already repeated in other chats cannot be recalled.
sharing.disclosure: The contact can recall facts learned from anyone here, including saved memories from before sharing. Chat transcripts and attachments stay private. Anyone can keep their own chat private in the contact’s details.
sharing.contributorNote: Your selected model is Contributor. Messages and shared memories sent to Meta may be used to train its models.

energy.title: Group energy
energy.info: Each group message uses one point. One point recharges every five minutes, even offline. Private replies do not use energy.
energy.unavailable: This contact is no longer available to its creator.

phones.title: Timers and alarms
phones.footerOwned: Just ask {name} in chat, for example {example}. If you don’t name anyone, it goes to your own phone. The phone gets it as a notification, even while locked, and the chat shows when it’s set.
phones.footerOthers: Just ask {name} in chat, for example {example}. Say whose phone you mean. The phone gets it as a notification, even while locked, and the chat shows when it’s set.
phones.exampleOther: “Set a timer on {owner}’s phone for 10 minutes”
phones.ownedSupporting: Timers and alarms you ask for
phones.sharedSupporting: They allowed you to send timers and alarms
phones.whoFooter: They can’t see your chats or anything else on your phone. Turning someone off doesn’t remove alarms they already set.
phones.youSupporting: From this browser and your other devices
phones.empty: {name} can set timers and alarms on an iPhone that allows it. On your iPhone, open this contact’s Native experiments and turn on Receive timers and alarms. People who also chat with {name} can let you use their phone the same way.

learning.title: Conversation learning
learning.intro: Contacts learn your interests and conversational preferences, notice their own repetition, and keep optional questions for relevant moments. Learning stays in this chat. In a group, this screen shows only learning about you, separately for each contact.
learning.introCorrect: You can correct a preference in conversation. Learning does not enable spontaneous messages or change a contact's configured personality.
learning.footer: Turning this off clears conversation learning about you. Turning it on starts with new messages. Factual memory has its own rules.
learning.nothing: Nothing learned yet. Contacts review recent exchanges as the conversation develops.
learning.resetConfirm: Reset learning about you in this chat? Contacts will learn again from new messages. Existing chat messages and factual memories stay available.
